runs.text: Thirty eight babies in every thousand died before their first birthday. That was Israel in nineteen sixty. Britain was at twenty three. Egypt and Turkey, more than one baby in six. Then the whole region starts racing down. Turkey cuts its rate by ninety five percent. Egypt falls from one seventy three to twenty one. Iran, from eighty eight to ten. Lebanon goes the other way. Since twenty fifteen, its crisis pushes the rate back up. Saudi Arabia and the UAE drop below five. America ends at five and a half. Britain at four point one. Which number surprised you most? Tell me in the comments. And Israel today? Two point seven. Down from thirty eight.
